key_insight: Openhagen Worlds measures experimental reasoning through 27 generated environments with explicit scoring rules, hidden truths and calibrated difficulty.
engineering_relevance: The suite provides budgeted, automatically verified tasks for training and evaluating agents that choose experiments and infer scientific answers.
method: Agents run experiments under a budget, then commit answers checked by deterministic verifiers.
Calibrate 178 levels on 64 development instances each, requiring high oracle success and low non-deductive and shortcut success.
Split tasks into 92 core levels for smaller models and 86 frontier levels featuring harder questions and multistage campaigns.
evidence_signal: On 84 withheld frontier instances, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solved 32 at default reasoning effort and 57 at maximum effort, versus 79 for the oracle.
watch_item: Calibration tests specified baseline and shortcut policies, so it does not establish resistance to every possible shortcut.
paper_title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
